hero.title: Is Princess Premier Worth It? Benefits, Costs and How to Decide
hero.subtitle: A complete guide to Princess Cruises' top-tier package, including unlimited specialty dining, top-shelf drinks, 4-device Wi-Fi, shore excursion credits, and 7-night vacation math.

introSection.heading: Evaluating Princess Premier's VIP Value
introSection.p1: Princess Premier is the most comprehensive of Princess Cruises' main onboard packages. It combines a premium beverage package, Wi-Fi for up to four devices per guest, crew appreciation, specialty and casual dining, shore excursion credit, professional photos, and reserved theater seating.
introSection.p2: But with a higher daily price than Princess Plus, is Princess Premier actually worth the extra money?
introSection.p3: The answer depends on how much of the package you will use. Guests who enjoy specialty restaurants, premium drinks, multiple connected devices, and organized shore excursions may find considerable value in Premier. Travelers who mainly want drinks, basic internet access, and a few casual dining experiences may find Princess Plus more economical.
introSection.p4: This guide explains the current Princess Premier price, what it includes, how much it adds to a cruise budget, and how to decide whether it is the right package for your sailing.

inclusions.title: What Does Princess Premier Include?
inclusions.subtitle: Nine signature luxury amenities and VIP privileges included in Princess Cruises' top package

features.title: 1. Premier Beverage Package
features.description: Unlimited eligible drinks priced up to $20 each with NO daily alcoholic beverage limit (top-shelf spirits, premium wines, craft cocktails, specialty coffees, teas, zero-proof mocktails, and bottled water), plus a 25% discount on wine bottles, 1L water bottles, and canned sodas.

features.title: 2. MedallionNet Max Wi-Fi (Up to 4 Devices)
features.description: Simultaneous high-speed satellite connectivity for up to four devices per guest, allowing phones, tablets, laptops, and smartwatches to remain online together without logging in and out.

features.title: 3. Daily Crew Appreciation (Gratuities)
features.description: Prepaid crew appreciation covered under eligible package terms ($18/day Balcony, $19/day Mini-Suite/Reserve Collection, $20/day Suite), saving $126–$140 per guest on a 7-night cruise.

features.title: 4. Unlimited Qualifying Specialty Dining
features.description: Covers restaurant cover charges for one qualifying specialty meal per mealtime, per day (lunch and dinner) at celebrated venues such as Crown Grill steakhouse, Sabatini's Italian Trattoria, and The Catch by Rudi.

features.title: 5. Unlimited Qualifying Casual Dining
features.description: Unlimited multi-course prix fixe meals at participating casual dining venues such as Alfredo's Pizzeria, Kai Sushi, and Ocean Terrace throughout the entire voyage.

features.title: 6. Shore Excursion Credit
features.description: Generous credit toward Princess-booked shore excursions: $100 per guest (6–9 days), $200 per guest (10–20 days), or $300 per guest (21+ days), automatically credited toward qualifying tours.

features.title: 7. Professional Photo Package
features.description: Unlimited digital downloads of all professional portrait and formal night photos featuring the guest taken by ship photographers, plus three commemorative printed photos per voyage.

features.title: 8. Reserved Theater Seating
features.description: Access to a designated prime seating section for eligible Broadway-style production shows in the Princess Theater, eliminating the need to arrive an hour early to secure prime seats.

features.title: 9. OceanNow & Room-Service Delivery
features.description: Waived one-time $14.99 OceanNow app delivery activation fee and complimentary room-service delivery on eligible food and beverage orders to your stateroom.

sevenNightMath.title: A Practical Seven-Night Cost-Benefit Example
sevenNightMath.subtitle: Examining the $735 package investment against itemized standalone retail prices

items.title: Crew Appreciation Covered
items.description: For a standard balcony stateroom ($18/day x 7 days), crew appreciation totals $126 per guest—a direct, guaranteed offset on your final onboard account.

items.title: Shore Excursion Credit
items.description: Every guest on a 7-night cruise receives a $100 credit toward eligible Princess shore excursions, immediately reducing the net cost of the package to $635.

items.title: Unlimited Specialty Dining
items.description: Dining at Crown Grill, Sabatini's, or The Catch by Rudi 4 to 6 times during the week ($45–$55 cover charge each) delivers up to $330 in culinary value.

items.title: Premier Drinks Package
items.description: Top-shelf spirits, premium wines up to $20, craft cocktails, lattes, and bottled water with no daily drink limit easily exceed $70+/day in retail spending.

items.title: 4-Device Wi-Fi & Photo Package
items.description: A 4-device Wi-Fi plan retails for ~$45/day ($315/week) and an unlimited digital cruise portrait package with prints retails for $150–$250 separately.

decisionGuide.title: Who Should Buy Princess Premier vs. Who May Not Need It
decisionGuide.consTitle: Who May Not Need Princess Premier
shouldBuy: You plan to dine at specialty restaurants multiple times or every evening of your cruise
You regularly order top-shelf liquors, craft cocktails, and premium wines priced between $15 and $20
You travel with multiple devices (smartphone, tablet, laptop) and need simultaneous internet access
You intend to book organized Princess shore excursions and will utilize the $100–$300 excursion credit
You value commemorative formal portraits, professional vacation photos, and reserved theater seating
You want an all-inclusive VIP cruise experience with zero daily budgeting worries
mayNotNeed: You rarely visit specialty dining venues and prefer the complimentary main dining rooms and buffet
You only connect a single smartphone for occasional messaging and social media
You are satisfied with cocktails and wine priced under $15 and drink fewer than 15 beverages daily
You plan mostly independent self-guided port visits rather than Princess shore excursions
You do not purchase onboard professional photographs and prefer keeping your upfront vacation fare lower (making Princess Plus a better value)

bookingRules.title: Important Princess Premier Booking Rules to Know
bookingRules.subtitle: Key guidelines, timing deadlines, and dining reservation advice before purchasing

steps.title: Purchase 96 Hours Before Departure
steps.description: To lock in the published pre-cruise rate ($105/day on standard fleet, $110 on Sun/Star Princess), add Premier at least four days before sailing. Purchasing onboard adds a $5 per person, per day surcharge.

steps.title: Reserve Specialty Dining Early
steps.description: Premier covers one specialty meal per mealtime, per day (lunch and dinner). Because popular dining times at Crown Grill and Sabatini's fill rapidly, reserve your preferred tables through the Princess app before departure.

steps.title: Redeem Shore Excursion Credits
steps.description: Your $100–$300 excursion credit applies only to eligible Princess-booked tours. Unused excursion credits expire at the end of the voyage and cannot be refunded or redeemed for cash.

steps.title: Theater Reserved Seating Guidelines
steps.description: Premier guests have access to a reserved seating block for eligible production shows. Arrive 15–30 minutes before showtime to select your preferred seats before unclaimed seats are opened to the general audience.

faqs.question: Is Princess Premier worth the money?
faqs.answer: Princess Premier can be worth the money if you regularly use specialty dining, eligible drinks, Wi-Fi for multiple devices, shore excursion credit, and professional photo benefits. Guests who would not use these services may find Princess Plus or the standard fare more economical.

faqs.question: How much does Princess Premier cost per day?
faqs.answer: The published pre-cruise USD rate is $105 per person, per day on most Princess ships and $110 on Sun Princess and Star Princess. The lower rate requires purchase at least 96 hours before departure.

faqs.question: How much is Princess Premier for a seven-day cruise?
faqs.answer: For a seven-night cruise, Princess Premier costs $735 per person on most ships or $770 per person on Sun Princess and Star Princess at published pre-cruise rates ($1,470 or $1,540 for two guests).

faqs.question: Does Princess Premier include unlimited drinks?
faqs.answer: It includes eligible drinks priced up to $20 each, with no daily limit on included alcoholic beverages under current package terms. Beverage exclusions and responsible-service rules apply.

faqs.question: Does Princess Premier include unlimited specialty dining?
faqs.answer: It includes qualifying specialty dining cover charges, limited to one specialty dining meal per mealtime per day (lunch and dinner). Supplementary menu items may cost extra, and reservations are subject to venue availability.

faqs.question: Does Princess Premier include unlimited casual dining?
faqs.answer: Yes. It includes unlimited qualifying prix fixe meals at participating casual dining venues (such as Alfredo's Pizzeria, Kai Sushi, and Ocean Terrace) throughout the voyage.

faqs.question: How much shore excursion credit does Princess Premier include?
faqs.answer: The current credit is $100 per guest for voyages of 6–9 days, $200 for voyages of 10–20 days, and $300 for voyages of 21 days or longer. The credit applies to eligible Princess-booked excursions and cannot be exchanged for cash.

faqs.question: Does Princess Premier include Wi-Fi for the whole family?
faqs.answer: It includes Wi-Fi for up to four devices per guest, not just four devices per stateroom. Each guest's allowance is subject to package terms and onboard network availability.

faqs.question: Does Princess Premier include gratuities?
faqs.answer: Eligible Princess Premier purchases include crew appreciation paid on behalf of guests under applicable terms ($18/day Balcony, $19/day Mini-Suite, $20/day Suite). Other service charges may still apply.

faqs.question: Does Princess Premier include professional photos?
faqs.answer: Yes. It includes unlimited eligible digital photo downloads featuring the guest and three printed photos per continuous voyage. Certain special photography services and events are excluded.

faqs.question: Is Princess Premier better than Princess Plus?
faqs.answer: Premier offers more benefits, including specialty dining, a higher beverage price limit ($20 vs $15), four-device Wi-Fi, shore excursion credit, professional photos, and reserved theater seating. Plus costs $35/day less and may be better for guests who mainly want drinks, one-device Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, and casual dining.

faqs.question: Is Princess Premier worth it for a couple?
faqs.answer: It can be worthwhile if both guests will use the dining, beverage, connectivity, and excursion benefits. Since the package is priced per person ($1,470 for two on a 7-night cruise), compare the combined cost with the services you would otherwise purchase separately.

faqs.question: Can I purchase Princess Premier after booking my cruise?
faqs.answer: Eligible guests can generally add the package through Princess Manage Booking, their travel advisor, or Princess directly. To receive the lower pre-cruise rate, purchase at least 96 hours before departure.
